core_obligations: Reduce the converse to a lifting condition: use the characterisation of formal smoothness, and transport the relevant tensor products along the faithfully flat base change to show the required exact sequence is exact upstairs (proof lines 38469-38495).
Use faithful flatness to bring exactness back down, and apply the characterisation once more to conclude (proof lines 38495-38500).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an exactness statement and check it upstairs (proof lines 38466-38495).
Descend exactness by faithful flatness (proof lines 38495-38501).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that formal smoothness is detected after a faithfully flat base change (statement lines 38459-38464). The proof does not work with the lifting property directly at the level of the base: it rewrites formal smoothness through the characterisation by an exact sequence, checks the corresponding exactness after the base change, and uses faithful flatness to bring it back down (proof lines 38466-38501). Choosing the exactness formulation, rather than the lifting formulation, is what makes faithful flatness applicable. H2.
